limitations: Post-hoc descriptive construct/influence audit of the same existing patients and cells.
The target is fibroblast high-fraction, NOT healing, treatment efficacy or clinical outcome.
DFU-only restriction removes the non-diabetic arm, not within-DFU confounding.
Topic means and target share fibroblasts; simplex/lineage composition dependencies remain.
Cell yield, dissociation, UMI and PTPRC contamination can remain technically confounded.
Leave-one-patient-out extrema are influence ranges, NOT confidence intervals.
No new patients/donors, model fits, causal/adjusted effects or independent clinical validation.
No p values, multiple-testing correction, significant labels or winner selection; not submission-ready.

parameters.comparison: Recompute original 20-patient rho and 20-deletion summaries against producing report
parameters.constant_policy: null rho with explicit status; constants checked on complete pairs
parameters.correlation: Pearson correlation of average-tie ranks (Spearman); no p-value routine
parameters.deletion: Each of the fixed 11 patients deleted exactly once per covariate; no resampling
parameters.invalid_policy: Reject infinity, invalid numeric strings and missing structural counts
parameters.missing_policy: Pairwise finite x/weight; retain every patient and covariate

saved_producing_protocol.composition: Pool each lineage count across specimens, divide by all patient cells
saved_producing_protocol.inference: No p/BH values, no causal or adjusted effect, no selection or independent validation; mixed clinical arms remain confounded
saved_producing_protocol.outcome: Patient fibroblast high-fraction at the current midpoint
saved_producing_protocol.specimen_order: Unweighted average of specimen G-number within patient; not a biological batch identifier
saved_producing_protocol.technical: Fibroblast-count-weighted mean of three saved specimen summaries; tech_umi is a mean of specimen medians, NOT a pooled-patient median
saved_producing_protocol.topic_means: Pool current deterministic fibroblast coordinates across patient specimens
saved_producing_protocol.uncertainty: Leave-one-patient-out influence range, NOT confidence bounds

parameters.target: weight: patient fibroblast high-fraction at the producing midpoint; not a healing outcome
parameters.tech_umi_definition: Fibroblast-count-weighted average of specimen median UMI counts; NOT a pooled-patient median

resources.gpu_compute: none; no GPU libraries imported or used
